abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, and MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE wrote combat.total_defense, which _resolve_damage recomputes from sum(card.defense) immediately before damage -- so the value was discarded even when something did set it. WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_DEFENSE with MODIFY_DEFENSE moves the DEFENDING CARD's own {d}, which is what survives into the total. 'Equipment have -1{d} while defending this combat chain' names the defending EQUIPMENT; the condition was a bare IN_COMBAT.
